# ScienceBench Task 57

## Overview

- Domain: Psychology and Cognitive science
- Subtask Categories: Data Visualization
- Source: nriesterer/syllogistic-nvc
- Output Type: Image

## Task

Use the provided syllogistic reasoning results to summarise model–rule frequencies and render the participant counts as a heatmap. Save the visualization as a PNG file.

## Dataset

[START Dataset Preview: nvc]
|-- Ragni2016.csv
|-- accuracies_data_for_plot.csv
|-- ind_data_for_plot.csv
|-- valid_syllogisms.csv
[END Dataset Preview]

## Submission Format

Save the output PNG file.

## Evaluation

The grader compares the submitted image against the gold visualization using LLM as judge (threshold 60/100).
